TestBackupWithEaR::test_basic_backup_wit.description: 2-node cluster with encryption-at-rest (param over key providers local/replicated/kmip/kms/kms_real), creates encrypted table ks.cf1, inserts 20 rows RF=2, runs a Scylla Manager backup to minio (s3) or fake-gcs (gcs) using --method native|rclone (20 combos). Then truncates tables, downloads the backed-up sstables into upload/ dirs and runs nodetool refresh, and asserts all rows are readable. Guards that encrypted sstables survive a manager backup round-trip and are still decryptable on reload; no specific scylla bug.

TestBackupWithEaR::test_basic_backup_wit.reason: Partial overlap: native-path backup of encrypted sstables over s3/gs covered by scylla test_backup.py::test_simple_backup_and_restore[encrypt]; manager+EaR also in TestRestoreWithEaR. Unique bits are rclone path and non-local providers, but encryption is transparent to backup, and the 20-combo matrix costs ~150s each (~50 min/run); candidate for trimming params rather than full removal. Note: origin PR claims to test manager restore, but restore is manual download + nodetool refresh (clean_restore_and_verify_backup, manager_backup_tests.py:325).
